advisories.finding: The inherited root checker prints PASS integrity: None files when its integrity() is skipped. JSON is truthful (null) and fusion reports zero, but an explicit SKIP label would communicate the omitted step more clearly.

Unlike the nested fusion adapter, the root integrity function replacement has no exact match-count assertion. The pinned source has exactly one such function, so current replay is correct; a count guard would make future source drift fail closed.

root_resolution: Both cosmetic SKIP label and exact-one integrity adapter guard added; corrected46 wrapper replay repeated after change.
